summary: scripts/ci-local lets the host's build admission see its stages: their own HOME hid the admission program, limits and queue state, so every build inside a stage took the shims' fallback cap instead of the host's queue

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

compatibility.detail: CI is unchanged. Locally the stages still run in a home of their own; only the variables the host's shims read for their own files are named from the account's home, and a value the caller set is kept.
